messages:
toni: Quick sync: external assessors next Tue. Need a short, testable playbook: ephemeral RBAC, KMS grant pattern, evidence manifest + verification, and clear retest sign-off owner.

rahul: Agreed. No long-lived roles. We'll create an per-engagement read-only S3 prefix and mint STS creds that expire after the window. Document the exact policy.

mei: For KMS: don't rotate keys pre-test. Create a grant scoped to Encrypt/Decrypt with an EncryptionContext tag and revoke immediately after. Ensure CloudTrail records kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey.

devops-bot: Info: CloudTrail -> SIEM forwarding active (index: "security_audit"). KMS events included. Default retention 90d hot / 365d cold.

toni: Short retest acceptance idea: fix merged + canary deployed, vendor smoke repro fails for 48h, logs contain no repro entries, KMS events limited to the test window, and verifier signs off in triage card. Who volunteers to certify?

rahul: I'll be primary verifier. If I'm OOO, Mei fallback. I'll create the triage template with checkboxes.

mei: Evidence manifest steps I'll include: generate tar, compute sha256, GPG-sign manifest, create presigned URL. Example commands I'll add to playbook:

```bash
# create presigned URL (24h)
aws s3 presign s3://pt-evidence/${ENG_ID}/bundle.tar.gz --expires-in 86400
# manifest
sha256sum bundle.tar.gz > bundle.sha256
# sign
gpg --detach-sign --local-user ops@redwood.com bundle.sha256
# revoke KMS grant
aws kms revoke-grant --key-id alias/pt-key --grant-id "$GRANT_ID"
```

toni: Also add a short jq filter for CloudTrail to pull kms events by correlation id. Keeps verification reproducible.

rahul: I'll schedule a 45m dry-run Mon 09:00 UTC to exercise the whole flow: bucket prep, grant issuance, presign, assessor pull, revoke, and verification checklist.

devops-bot: Reminder set: dry-run Mon 09:00 UTC. Will post preflight checklist at T-30m.

mei: One more: enforce a 4h RBAC freeze during the active window; any emergency exceptions must have a Jira link and approval from on-call. Document in playbook.

toni: Perfect. Actions: mei=playbook+commands+manifest signing, rahul=triage template+certifier, toni=vendor DM + dry-run agenda. We'll iterate here. :lock:
